decisions.reason: GA4 is now Google's only analytics standard, so a GA4 tracking plugin serves continuing demand from shop clients and fits the firm's core e-commerce business.
Google stopped Universal Analytics data processing in July 2023, so the plugin no longer works and falls short of any aspiration, and its maintenance resources are better moved to the GA4 plugin.
A retail system interface plugin fits the firm's shop integration work, has low running costs and plausible client demand, so modest slack lets the firm keep it while results are uncertain.
The SEO relaunch service is featured on its own page and builds on the firm's consultancy skills with little fixed cost, so there is no performance shortfall to trigger dropping it.
